annotations.title: Get the auditor of an issuer

description: get_auditor is the auditor of an issuer: an issuer by ticker, ISIN or LEI returns its auditor of record and every auditor change on the record, dated — each with its source page and read date, signed by the node of the issuer's market and receipted. Where a market's record does not carry the auditor, the answer says not_on_record for that market; nothing is inferred. Typed errors: unknown_issuer, ambiguous, not_on_record (per field, per market), invalid_request. Door: https://mcp.getauditor.ai/mcp (routes to the owning node); every node door answers it for its own market.

issuer.description: Ticker (with exchange where it helps: NASDAQ:AAPL, SHEL.L), ISIN or LEI.

name: get_auditor
title: Get the auditor of an issuer
